name.ja: ハローキティ×ハロ（アニバーサリーモデル）

description.ja: 夢のハローキティとガンダムのコラボ企画！
description.en: A dream collaboration project between Hello Kitty and Gundam!

description.ja: ハローキティとガンダムのコラボレーションに合わせ、驚愕の和解モデルが登場！！
description.en: In conjunction with the collaboration between Hello Kitty and Gundam, an amazing reconciliation model has been released! !

description.ja: • 新規造形の耳とリボンが付属、ハナやヒゲ等を付属シールで再現できます。
description.en: • Newly sculpted ears and ribbons are included, and you can reproduce the ears, whiskers, etc. with the included seal.

description.ja: • 耳と口の開閉や、手足の展開状態に組み換えも可能です。
description.en: • It is also possible to open and close the ears and mouth, and to open and close the arms and legs.
